name: Lune
description: Lune connects Claude with research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows. Ask a question in plain English, and Lune retrieves relevant papers from top-tier academic conferences, complete with abstracts, metadata, citation links, and full text when available. It also provides curated guidance for literature reviews, evaluation design, ablation studies, and venue selection. From early ideas to publication-ready research, Lune helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper literature grounding, and more rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lune to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lune to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.luneresearch.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lune MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lune provides these MCP tools: extract_from_papers, gather_evidence, get_conference_papers, get_paper_citations, get_paper_fulltext, get_research_guidance_doc, list_conferences, search_papers, search_papers_many, search_related_papers, search_research_guidance, and verify_claims.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lune?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lune in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Lune requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lune is developed by Lune Research. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
